features.name: Live charts in spreadsheets
features.description: Create live charts in spreadsheets that update when data in Business Central changes. Demonstrated by adding a chart region that displays customer sales data.

features.name: Table regions for data display
features.description: Create table regions in spreadsheets to display and grab data from Business Central tables, such as the customer table with columns for number, name, and sales.

features.name: Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting app
features.description: An app for Business Central that enables creating spreadsheets with live charts, table regions, and data visualization capabilities. The app is free to try in a sandbox environment.
caveats: Free to try only in sandbox cloud environments

features.name: Column charts
features.description: Support for column chart type in spreadsheets. Can be configured with data and categories to visualize customer sales information.
